page.overview:
What is Kite?

Kites were lifeforms native to the Frontier moon Clytemnestra. They possessed thin–skinned bodies that allowed them to ride on the harsh winds on the moon, as well as chemical fluids that combusted on contact with the air. A United States Colonial Marine Corps mission was sent by Weyland-Yutani Corporation to capture a live kite so as to harvest its fluids.
